weaponsurge.def: A stacking damage buff for weapons of one damage type (Arc, Solar, Void, Stasis or Strand).
weaponsurge.q: grants 4 Stacks of Weapon Surge matching the element of the used ability

weapondamage.def: A temporary increase to your outgoing weapon damage (Empowering buffs and exotic stacking bonuses).

handcannon.def: Hand Cannon weapons; some exotics only work while one is equipped or readied.
handcannon.q: while a Hand Cannon is equipped

sidearm.def: Sidearm weapons; some exotics buff them or trigger on readying one.
sidearm.q: Increases Sidearm airborne effectiveness, ready speed, and reload speed.

bow.def: Bow weapons; some exotics change how their draw works or boost their damage.
bow.q: Bow perfect draw can be held indefinitely.

glaive.def: Glaive weapons, with both a projectile and a melee attack; some exotics buff either.
glaive.q: Increases Glaive reload speed and melee damage when surrounded.

primaryweapon.def: Weapons that use Primary ammo; some exotics trigger on their final blows.
primaryweapon.q: Final blows with Primary ammo weapons return dodge energy
